about: SEQUENCE layers (r183, docs/sequence-layers.md phase 2): conformance pages with layers chaining loud segments (core/test-data/sequence/segments.png, in HiverSeq.atlas) in cycles drawn from a seed, in every repeat mode, with a game seed and through a cross-fade. Godot draws its own cycle (plax_page.gd's draw_cycle): a pick that differs from core's SequenceCycle shows as a segment of another colour and width. Written by core/test-data/sequence/make_round.py; picks.json is tests/sequence_cycle.gd's table (tools/r183-sequence/PickTable.java). Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.

scenes.name: sequence-repeat-X
scenes.about: c01 (repeat X, useOriginalSize): a padded 12-slot strip seeded negative between the hills, a weighted 16-slot ground of five in front, the bush packed stripped

scenes.name: sequence-repeat-XY
scenes.about: c02 (repeat X and Y, padded), scrolling up at 30 units/s too: a 4-slot cycle repeating in view, padded both ways; the bridge weighs 0 and never shows

scenes.name: sequence-repeat-Y-mirror
scenes.about: c03 (repeat Y, mirrored copies to the right), scrolling up at 30 units/s too: a flipped 3-slot cycle and its mirrored copy

scenes.name: sequence-no-repeat
scenes.about: c05 (no repeat): an upside-down cycle drawn once from seed 0; slots going back after each tower by a pad of -16 (every slot walked: a search would miss some)

scenes.name: sequence-game-seed
scenes.about: q01 drawn from a game seed (183, XORed with each layer's): another ground than q01's

scenes.name: sequence-cross-fade-seeded
scenes.about: q01 from a negative game seed cross-fading into q02 (its cycles drawn from the same game seed) 4 s in, over 4 s
